chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his brother Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Umar al-Halabi, from al-Husayn ibn Musa, from Ma'mar ibn Yahya ibn Sam, from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:

"As if I see a people who have risen in the East, seeking the truth but they are not given it. Then they seek it again but they are not given it. When they see that, they place their swords on their necks (unsheathe them), and they are given what they asked for but they do not accept it until they rise (revolt). And they do not deliver it except to your Master. Their slain are martyrs. Indeed, if I were to live until that time, I would sacrifice myself to the Master of this Matter."

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: the Master of the Matter (referring to the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the people rising from the East in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) foretells the 'Khurasanis,' a group from the East who, after being denied the truth, will rise with swords to deliver the Mahdi (AJ). This narrative underscores the pivotal role of military uprising in establishing justice and highlights the high spiritual status of those who fall in this cause as martyrs, reflecting the Imam's personal eagerness to join them.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (50) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan from his brother Muhammad bin al-Hasan from his father from Ahmad bin Umar al-Halabi from al-Husayn bin Musa from Ma’mar bin Yahya bin Sam from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“As if I see some people rising in the east. They will ask for the truth but they will not be given it. They will ask for it again and they will not be given it. Then they will unsheathe their swords and they will be given what they will ask for but they will not accept it. They will revolt and deliver their victory to your man (al-Mahdi). Their killed ones will be martyrs. If I live until that time, I will sacrifice myself to the man of this matter.”
